compute_virtual_topk_ids: compute virtual topk ids by combining token lora mapping with expert routing ids and num experts
sanitize_expert_ids: sanitize expert ids by replacing values exceeding num virtual experts with -1
run_moe_lora_shrink_splitk: run split-K grouped GEMM for the LoRA A shrink stage with virtual expert routing
invoke_fused_moe_lora_add: invoke fused MoE kernel to apply LoRA A and LoRA B weights with virtual expert routing and add to output
merge_lora_expert_weights: merge LoRA expert weights from max loras times num experts shape to flat virtual expert shape
